extra-detail-member.json.rule: detail is not used: it could echo input

extra-stack-trace-member.json.rule: no stack trace, no other member (NFR-SEC-03)

type-wrong-prefix.json.rule: type is urn:vulnmart:error: plus the code

request-id-too-short.json.rule: request_id is 8 to 64 letters, digits and hyphens

errors-empty.json.rule: errors has at least one entry

errors-echoes-value.json.rule: an error entry never carries the submitted value

unknown-code.json.rule: the code is not in the registry

status-differs-from-registry.json.rule: status must equal the registry status of the code

title-differs-from-registry.json.rule: title must equal the registry title of the code

type-differs-from-code.json.rule: type must be urn:vulnmart:error: plus the same code

request-id-illegal-chars.json.rule: request_id is 8 to 64 letters, digits and hyphens

field-bad-escape.json.rule: a JSON Pointer escapes only ~0 and ~1

errors-pointer-bad-escape.json.rule: a JSON Pointer escapes only ~0 and ~1
